name: tinycast
description: Tinycast — a tiny, fully native macOS launcher, hotkeys, and clipboard history.
one_liner: A tiny, lightning-fast app launcher for Mac that pops up with one keystroke to open apps, run quick commands, and browse what you've recently copied, using almost no memory.
buyer: A power-user Mac professional (consultant, developer, designer) who'd pay a small one-time fee for a leaner, faster alternative to Alfred or Raycast.
business_use_cases: Sell it as a paid App Store app targeting the 'Raycast/Alfred feels too heavy' crowd of performance-conscious Mac users.
An IT department standardizes on it fleet-wide as a lightweight, low-resource productivity tool for company laptops.
Bundle it with other lean utilities into a 'minimalist productivity pack' sold to freelancers and consultants.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a one-time paid version or Pro unlock on the Mac App Store
Offer a 'pay what you want' donation tier for the free version

steal_this: This weekend, package a polished $9 'Pro' version (extra hotkeys, themes) and list it on the Mac App Store aimed squarely at users complaining Raycast is bloated.
